This analysis revealed, on one hand, a CYP2D6 intermediate metabolizer (CYP2D6*5/*27) status, characterized by a complete loss of an allele activity (CYP2D6*5) and a normal activity of another allele (CYP2D6*27), and, on the other hand, a CYP2C19 poor metabolizer (CYP2C19*2/*2 – complete loss of both alleles’ activity) status."
Sentence: CYP2C19 *2/*2 (assigned as poor metabolizer phenotype) is associated with increased concentrations of desvenlafaxine and venlafaxine in women with Overdose and Emergencies.
